name: Example: User Tree Sprite Pack
author: Golf Tycoon examples
description: A data-only visual mod that replaces every shipped tree sprite with a user-created four-view set: oak, pine, maple, birch, palm, dead tree, cactus, bush, fescue, cattails and heather. The flat tree_art folder makes these replacements apply in every season, so it works whether the Seasons mod is enabled or not.
